archived.description: Boolean flag used to determine if the account is archived.

code.description: Account code or number used in the accounting system's chart of accounts. Maximum length: 255 characters.

companyId.description: Pleo's internal identifier for the company the account is associated with.

externalId.description: Non empty unique external identifier of the account, assigned in the external ERP/accounting system. Can be the same as code if no other identifier is available. Maximum length: 255 characters.

additionalProperties.description: Place for API users to store flexible data.

metadata.description: Place for API users to store flexible data.

name.description: Name of the account. Maximum length: 255 characters.

taxCodeExternalId.description:
The identifier in **the target system** for the tax code the account is associated with.
- This is NOT the tax percentage (e.g. 20%)
- This is NOT the Pleo UUID of the tax code
